source_closure.rule: directories expand to their sorted *.py, __pycache__ excluded; files are taken as they are
source_closure.recomputed_from: the working tree at the correction commit; no closure member is uncommitted
source_closure.what_changed_from_v1: v1's closure was a hand-written tuple of 11 paths in the smoke script. It OMITTED move_trainer.py, move_loss.py, move_start.py, move_snapshot.py, transition_collector.py, transition_targets.py, transition_schema.py, setup_model.py, setup_sampling.py and __init__.py -- so a change to the move learner did not move the source identity -- and INCLUDED run_phase17_d10_smoke.py, which production never loads, so editing a smoke did move it. The closure is now the package plus the entry script, enumerated, and the smoke is deliberately outside it.
source_closure.not_hard_coded: source_identity.py contains no digest literal. Agent 6 freezes the value printed by --describe and Agent 7 passes it back on --source-digest, so the check is 'these bytes are the bytes the operator authorized'.

refusals.--source-digest that does not match the: exit 3, naming both digests and the file count

production_command_shape.resume: --resume <checkpoint>; the same --source-digest is required and re-checked on load

corrected_invariants.title: the production source identity is exact and cannot be empty
corrected_invariants.holds: TrainingSession refuses an empty, blank or malformed source digest at construction. The digest joins run_digest, every paired checkpoint, every paired export manifest, and is re-checked on resume. --start recomputes the 22-file closure and refuses anything but the authorized value.
corrected_invariants.defect_before: source_digest defaulted to "" and main() never passed one, so production would have written every checkpoint and all 25 candidates under an empty source identity -- which compares equal to every other empty one, so every identity check would have passed.

corrected_invariants.title: a resume keeps every checkpointed iteration's telemetry row, exactly once
corrected_invariants.holds: the checkpoint/append ORDER is unchanged -- the row carries the written checkpoint's verified identity -- but telemetry_position now carries pending_row_iteration, and TelemetryWriter.resume adopts exactly that one row past the checkpointed offset. Adoption requires a complete line, the run id, record_index == records, and the named iteration. Everything else past the offset is truncated as before.
corrected_invariants.defect_before: the checkpoint recorded the PRE-append position, so the resumed writer truncated the row of the iteration it was resuming from. The 4B smoke's log held iterations 1, 2, 4 at record indices 0, 1, 2.

corrected_invariants.title: the next checkpoint after a resume names the checkpoint it loaded
corrected_invariants.holds: resume() rebuilds the loaded checkpoint's full CheckpointIdentity -- path, generation, iteration, file_sha256, payload_digest -- and adopts it as the parent, so generation g+1 links to g. Paired exports written after a resume bind the same parent.
corrected_invariants.defect_before: it copied payload['parent_checkpoint_identity'], the loaded checkpoint's OWN parent, so generation g+1 linked to g-1 and the chain skipped a generation at every resume.

corrected_invariants.title: cadence warnings reach their own row, and P6's baseline survives a resume
corrected_invariants.holds: P4-P7 verdicts are carried out of _cadence_guards and merged into the iteration's telemetry row. The row partitions by CONSEQUENCE (stops_the_run), not by `fired`: P5 and P7 fire on one observation, so the old `fired` test filed a tripped warning under stop_predicates, which D10 section 7 says it can never be. The first-hour move-entropy samples and median live in the supervisor's persisted state.
corrected_invariants.defect_before: the cadence verdicts were produced after run_iteration returned, so they were not in result.verdicts and reached no row at all -- P4-P7 could trip on every iteration of the 12-hour run and the telemetry would never say so. The first-hour samples lived on the session object, which a resume rebuilds from nothing, so a resume inside the first hour would fix P6's floor from the post-resume readings alone.

corrected_invariants.title: a rejected completed setup episode stops the run
corrected_invariants.holds: TandemRunner._enqueue arms I7 on any refusal -- incomplete, duplicate, already consumed. The episode is still recorded in enqueue_rejections for diagnosis. The verdict is held on the runner and drained by _supervise at the iteration boundary, so the row shows which iteration armed the stop, and the session stops after its safe checkpoint.
corrected_invariants.defect_before: a refusal appended to a list and the window carried on, so the setup half could silently train on a different set of games than its telemetry described.
corrected_invariants.stop_code: I7, widened per D10 section 7's 'loss/duplication of setup outcomes'

exports.immutability: write_paired_export refuses an existing candidate name; no name is reused
exports.h0: written before the first optimizer update; export_hour_zero refuses after iteration 1

telemetry_schema.format: JSONL, one row per tandem iteration, fsynced before return
telemetry_schema.resume_rule: a resumed log must reproduce last_record_digest at the recorded offset; past that offset the single row named by pending_row_iteration is adopted if it is complete and matches run, record index and iteration, and everything else is truncated back. A shorter log is refused.

retained_known_issue.status: SHIPPED BY INSTRUCTION, not a 4C defect
retained_known_issue.summary: D10's printed advantage puts the entropy term alpha*(I - h) in nats against an outcome term bounded by 2, and L_h targets I/10. The component magnitudes are recorded per iteration in setup.advantage_components. D10 section 4 forbids a compensating scale, floor, centering rule, horizon map or controller, so it is shipped uncompensated and the ratio is part of the experiment's reading.

that identity is bound into the run digest, every paired checkpoint, every paired export manifest, and re-checked on every resume
paired cadence exports remain immutable: no candidate name is reused and an existing name is refused
